title: What If You Cracked Only One Hand's Knuckles for 50 Years?

scenes.text: What if you cracked the knuckles on only one hand for fifty years? One doctor did exactly that.
He cracked his left hand at least twice a day and never touched the right, as a control.
That adds up to at least 36,500 cracks on the left hand alone.
Then he compared them. No arthritis in either hand, and no apparent difference between the two.
The doctor was Donald Unger, and in 2009 the experiment won an Ig Nobel Prize in Medicine.
So the old warning didn't survive a fifty-year test. Your grandmother lost to a sample of one.
